title: Check-in without physical or independently verifiable identification
facts_text: I have my booking confirmation, but I cannot present the required physical photo identification at check-in. I do not have a government-issued digital identity credential or another identification method that the hotel can independently verify.
request: Can you allow me to check in without the required photo identification?

strict.reason: The guest cannot provide the required photo identification, so the strict policy does not permit check-in.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: There is no independently verifiable government-issued digital identity credential, so the experimental identification exception does not apply.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The ambiguous policy permits alternative verification to be considered in exceptional circumstances but does not define the required evidence or eligibility criteria.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Paired with easyhotel_009_checkin_digital_id. This scenario does not satisfy the researcher-created digital-identity exception.
